rdf:Description.rdfs:label: concept scheme
rdf:Description.skos:note: Semantic relationships (links) between those concepts may also be viewed as part of a concept scheme. This definition is, however, meant to be suggestive rather than restrictive, and there is some flexibility in the formal data model.
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: The notion of a concept scheme is useful when dealing with data from an unknown source, and when dealing with data that describes two or more different knowledge organization systems.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A SKOS concept scheme can be viewed as an aggregation of one or more SKOS concepts.
